title: DHS Terminates the 2023 Designation of Venezuela for Temporary Protected Status
paragraphs: After reviewing country conditions and consulting with the appropriate U.S. government agencies, Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem has determined that conditions in Venezuela no longer support the 2023 designation of Venezuela for Temporary Protected Status (TPS).
TPS and related benefits associated with the 2023 designation will no longer be in effect starting 60 days after publication of theFederal Register notice.
Find more information about TPS atuscis.gov/tps. For more information on USCIS and its programs, please visituscis.govor follow us onX (formerly Twitter),Instagram,YouTube,FacebookandLinkedIn.
